notes: All prices are Digi-Key US prices in USD, taken on the retrieval date from Digi-Key product pages opened in this session. Some source_url values are Digi-Key keyword searches that redirect straight to the product page. epc-co.com returned HTTP 403 to automated access, Mouser returned an access-denied page or timed out, and Octopart returned 403. No EPC, Mouser or Octopart prices were captured. Prices exclude US tariffs, which Digi-Key adds in the cart, and the $7 Digi-Reel fee. 'Largest listed break' = largest Tape & Reel break. Digi-Key cut-tape breaks stop at 500 pcs. So for '~1k' prices this file uses the 500+ cut-tape price, which is what a 1,000-pc cut-tape order pays, unless a 1,000-pc reel break exists; each entry states its basis. EPC table check (Digi-Key largest break / table): median ratio 1.001, range 0.971-1.308. 11 of 20 parts are within 0.5% of the table value (EPC2055, EPC2066, EPC2069, EPC2302, EPC2367, EPC2619, EPC2031, EPC2065, EPC2023, EPC2024, EPC2366). EPC2218, EPC2204, EPC2204A, EPC2016C, EPC2020 and EPC2071 are about 6% higher (1.056-1.063). EPC2045 is 1.126 (only a 2,500 reel break listed). EPC2090 is 1.308, but Digi-Key lists only a 2,500 reel break, priced above its own 500-pc cut-tape price, so that ratio is suspect. EPC2014C is 0.971. At the 2,500-pc reel break specifically, parts that also have a 7,500 break are 6-12% above the table (see per-part notes). The table values match the largest-break prices better. EPC2031 is Obsolete at Digi-Key. EPC7xxx rad-hard parts are sold by Digi-Key under EPC Space, LLC in several suffix variants. The lowest-priced variant was recorded, with breaks only at 1 and 10 pcs and no ~1k price. Digi-Key lists uP1966E with manufacturer 'EPC'. MLCC: 22 of 24 found. GRM155D71E105KE11 and GRM188C81E106ME01 are not on Digi-Key, even as stems, so they may be invalid part numbers; they are null. Many MLCCs (and EPC2088, EPC2214, LMG1210) show zero stock with restock dates, given per entry. price_breaks holds every break captured as [qty, unit_price_usd].
